title: [A.ver] Teacher List – Eligible subject filter – Multiple selected subjects – Only full matches are displayed
description: AC 01, AC 04 — Decision Table — The Teacher list applies AND matching to the selected eligible subjects.
preconditions:
- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the A.ver Salesforce org.
- The eligible-subject filter customization is enabled for A.ver.
- Teacher A is eligible for Mathematics, English, and Science; Teacher B is eligible for Mathematics and English; Teacher C is eligible for Mathematics and Science.
steps_actions:
1. Open the Teacher list.
2. Select Mathematics, English, and Science in the Eligible Subject filter.
3. Apply the filter.
steps_result:
1. The Eligible Subject filter is available.
2. All three subjects appear as active criteria.
3. Teacher A is displayed; Teachers B and C are not displayed.

title: [A.ver] Teacher List – Eligible subject filter – Partial match – Teacher is omitted from results
description: AC 02 — Negative — A teacher who matches one of two selected subjects is omitted from the filtered list.
preconditions:
- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the A.ver Salesforce org.
- The eligible-subject filter customization is enabled for A.ver.
- Teacher B is eligible for Mathematics only; Teacher C is eligible for English only; no teacher is eligible for both subjects.
steps_actions:
1. Open the Teacher list.
2. Select Mathematics and English in the Eligible Subject filter.
3. Apply the filter.
4. Search for Teacher B and Teacher C.
steps_result:
1. The Eligible Subject filter is available.
2. Both subjects appear as active criteria.
3. The list shows no matching teacher.
4. Neither teacher is returned while both subjects remain selected.
steps_data:
1. tenant = A.ver
2. required_subjects = {Mathematics, English}
3. Teacher B = {Mathematics}; Teacher C = {English}; full_matches = none
4. search_names = Teacher B, Teacher C

title: Teacher List – Eligible subject filter – Non-A.ver tenant – Existing OR matching is retained
description: AC 05 — Regression — The tenant-specific configuration does not change the existing non-A.ver OR filter behavior.
preconditions:
- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to a non-A.ver tenant where the A.ver customization is not enabled.
- Teacher B is eligible for Mathematics only; Teacher C is eligible for English only.
steps_actions:
1. Open the Teacher list.
2. Select Mathematics and English in the Eligible Subject filter.
3. Apply the filter.
steps_result:
1. The Eligible Subject filter is available.
2. Both subjects appear as active criteria.
3. Teachers B and C are displayed because each matches at least one selected subject.
